race.comment: INDIGO STAR (4) has been plying his trade in harder NSW contests of late and should appreciate the drop back in company here. Has placed four of five over this distance range and is drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley. Looks well placed and gets his chance to finally break through. The well-related WEE WINN (11) (half to G2 winner Gunnison) is another to bring NSW form to the table and has been given a bit of freshen-up since that last Kembla outing. Respect any push in betting. BEV'S SPECIAL (9) also hails from a handy family (half to G2 winner Every Rose) and will be better with that debut effort now under the belt. Shapes as a leading contender with natural improvement. AGADOO (8) has hit the top-five at her past nine starts and rarely puts in a poor one. A must for the exotics players. I AM LOUIE (3) best of the rest while fresh.
